entries.notes: Polite standard greeting at any time of day.
Only with close friends or younger people.
Also used for 'my' with family/home: 우리 엄마.
Attach to a name, never to your own.

example.en: I want to become a doctor.
There are a lot of people.
What are you doing this weekend?

entries.notes: Also used to get attention: 'excuse me'.
Used for counting things and age. 한 before a counter.

example.en: I have a lot of work.
